verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a system-level package manager for CLI tools and apps. Monorepo workspace concepts, such as running installs or scripts filtered to the workspace packages a change affects, fall outside its product category. The evidence shows only per-project Brewfiles (brew bundle) and no workspace or package-graph notion, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)
